free_tier.stated: Tunnels on a random subdomain are free, with HTTPS, WebSockets and the request log. No card is needed. The Free plan has no time limit.

egress.terms: Unlimited tunnels on a random subdomain; no byte allowance is published in either direction.; ingress: http-only

interface_detail: CLI plus request log in the dashboard.

limits.value: No quota is published, so at 1 TiB/month the thing that fails is an unpublished per-caller tolerance. Protocol fails first in practice: HTTPS and WebSockets only, with no TCP or UDP port.

binding_note: No quota is published, so at 1 TiB/month the thing that fails is an unpublished per-caller tolerance. Protocol fails first in practice: HTTPS and WebSockets only, with no TCP or UDP port.

identity_cost.detail: 'No card is needed'; a login is required to start a tunnel.

reliability_note: Random subdomain on free; reserved names are the paid feature.
confidence_note: A TCP or UDP tunnel type on any plan would change this; the pricing page lists only HTTP-shaped features.

evidence.proved: 'Tunnels on a random subdomain are free, with HTTPS, WebSockets and the request log'; 'The Free plan has no time limit'

notes: Free is genuinely unmetered in count and time, which is rare; the disqualifier is the protocol.

extras.volume_stated: Unlimited tunnels on a random subdomain; no byte allowance is published in either direction.
